environment.description: Migration job executes inside a process namespace with pivot_root(2) into /srv/migration-sandbox which is a minimal tmpfs overlay. The process confinement is established by the container entrypoint wrapper (github.com/opencontainers/runc with custom spec). The new root contains only: /app/migrations/*.xml (read-only bind from validated source), /app/data/ (rw, empty sqlite target), /usr/lib/ and /usr/local/lib/python3.11/ (read-only, interpreter libs), and /proc (hidepid=2). No /etc directory exists in the chroot. No /run/secrets. No network interfaces are configured in the network namespace (unshare -n). DNS resolution is unavailable. The pivot_root target has nosuid,nodev,noexec on all mounts except /app/data. The process runs under a dedicated UID (65534) with no supplementary groups. Importantly, the XML parser's resolve_entities and load_dtd options still function syntactically, but entity resolution targeting file:// URIs will only see the sandboxed filesystem contents (migration XMLs and empty data directory), and http:// or https:// URIs will fail with ENETUNREACH since no network stack is available in the namespace.
